steps.text: Bring a shovel, and destroy field runes or an antidote for the poison fields.
steps.source: Useful Items: Destroy Field Runes, Antidote Runes or Antidote Spell. (On the 7.1 map the hole needs a shovel.)

steps.text: From Ab'Dendriel's gate go south, west and north to Elvenbane castle and open the hole between the four stones with your shovel.
steps.source: Start off at the gate of Ab'Dendriel. Go south, west and north to Elvenbane Castle. Drop down the hole surrounded by four stones.

steps.text: Run north and west through the basement (orc warriors and spearmen, minotaurs) and up into the castle.
steps.source: Run north and west to the opening. Here you may meet an Orc Berserker and a Minotaur Guard. Also a few Minotaurs and an Orc Spearman.

steps.text: Run around (orcs, minotaurs, an orc berserker) and up into the middle tower.
steps.source: Run around and enter the middle tower.

steps.text: Cross the poison fields (destroy field) and go up: a dragon is waiting.
steps.source: The first floor of the tower is entirely covered by poison fields. Prepare for the dragon upstairs.

steps.text: Kill the dragon or run past it to the ladder.
steps.source: On this floor you will face a Dragon. Kill the dragon or run past it to the ladder.

steps.text: Kill the orc shaman and the minotaur mage and go up again.
steps.source: On this floor there is an Orc Shaman and a Minotaur Mage. Kill them and continue climb the stairs.

steps.text: Kill the 2 demon skeletons and the elf arcanist.
steps.source: There are also 2 Demon Skeletons and an Elf Arcanist. Kill them and open the quest chests/drawers.

steps.text: Open the chest: a morning star.
steps.source: The final floor contains 2 quest chests and 2 quest drawers.

steps.text: And the other chest: a dwarven shield.
steps.source: The final floor contains 2 quest chests and 2 quest drawers.
